Akron ranks 114th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on % of trips. Team leaders Kent State Passing: Dru DeShields, 1,145 yards, 4 TDs, 6 INTs, 57.3 completion percentage Rushing: Mason King, 202 yards on 52 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Wayne Harris, 384 yards on 30 catches, 1 TD Akron Passing: Brayden Roggow, 1,068 yards, 7 TDs, 8 INTs, 59.0 completion percentage Rushing: Jordan Gant, 452 yards on 98 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Marcel Williams, 332 yards on 31 catches, 3 TDs Last game Kent State fell to South Florida 29-2 on Oct. 17. Brendyn Smith had four receptions for 56 yards. Akron lost 34-14 to Miami (OH) on Oct. 17. Roggow passed for 234 yards on 22-of-38 attempts (57.9%) with one touchdown and four interceptions. Gant had 46 rushing yards on 15 carries and one touchdown, adding two receptions for seven yards. Miles Burris had six receptions for 54 yards.
